jp: ちょっと体が大きくて力が強くて毛深いくらいで熊呼ばわりってみんな酷すぎるよ。傷つくんだよね…。
jp_grezzo: "ちょっと体が大きくて力が強くて毛深いくらいで熊呼ばわりってみんな酷すぎるよ。傷つくんだよね…。"
en: Just because I'm a bit big, pretty strong, and have thick hair, everyone calls me a bear. It hurts, you know...
en_grezzo: "Just because I'm a bit big, pretty strong, and have thick hair, everyone calls me a bear. It hurts, you know..."
it: Solo perché sono un po' grossa, forte e pelosa mi danno tutti dell'orsa. Siete cattivi. Ci resto male, sai...

jp: このネフィアの一番下層に混沌の神的なものが眠っていて、それが異変の原因になっている！
jp_grezzo: "このネフィアの一番下層に混沌の神的なものが眠っていて、それが異変の原因になっている！"
en: The God of Chaos on the lowest level of this ruin must be the cause of the incidents!
en_grezzo: "The God of Chaos on the lowest level of this ruin must be the cause of the incidents!"
it: In fondo a questa Nefia dorme qualcosa di simile al dio del caos, ed è quello la causa degli sconvolgimenti!

jp: って私の冒険者としての勘が言うからここに来ているんだけど。他にも複数の冒険者が下層に向かっているみたい。うーん。みんな勘がいいんだなぁ。
jp_grezzo: "って私の冒険者としての勘が言うからここに来ているんだけど。他にも複数の冒険者が下層に向かっているみたい。うーん。みんな勘がいいんだなぁ。"
en: My intuition as an adventurer brought me here. It look like several others are trying to reach the lowest level too... Yep. Everyone must be able to feel it.
en_grezzo: "My intuition as an adventurer brought me here. It look like several others are trying to reach the lowest level too... Yep. Everyone must be able to feel it."
it: ...Così dice il mio fiuto da avventuriera, ed è per quello che sono qui. Pare che anche parecchi altri avventurieri stiano scendendo verso il fondo. Mah. Fiuto ne hanno tutti, eh.

jp: この街も年中雪が降ってるけど、メイルーンに比べれば全然暖かいほうだよ。このくらいなら裸で走りまわっても平気だね。
jp_grezzo: "この街も年中雪が降ってるけど、メイルーンに比べれば全然暖かいほうだよ。このくらいなら裸で走りまわっても平気だね。"
en: It is snowing all year round in this city, but it is warmer than Mayroon at all. Even if I run around naked this much, I am fine.
en_grezzo: "It is snowing all year round in this city, but it is warmer than Mayroon at all. Even if I run around naked this much, I am fine."
it: Anche qui nevica tutto l'anno, ma in confronto a Mayroon fa un caldo che non ti dico. Con questa roba qui posso correre in giro nuda senza problemi.

jp: 協力ありがとう、助かったよ。後の掃除は私一人で出来る…というかやらせてよ。私を熊呼ばわりしてからかっていた連中に活躍を見せつけておかなきゃいけない。…なんてね。
jp_grezzo: "協力ありがとう、助かったよ。後の掃除は私一人で出来る…というかやらせてよ。私を熊呼ばわりしてからかっていた連中に活躍を見せつけておかなきゃいけない。…なんてね。"
en: Thanks for your help. I couldn't have done defeated that demon without you. I can handle the rest of the by myself... Or perhaps I should say, let me handle it. I need to show all those people who called me \"bear\" and made fun of me what I'm made of... Just kidding.
en_grezzo: "Thanks for your help. I couldn't have done defeated that demon without you. I can handle the rest of the by myself... Or perhaps I should say, let me handle it. I need to show all those people who called me \"bear\" and made fun of me what I'm made of... Just kidding."
it: Grazie dell'aiuto, mi hai salvata. Il resto della pulizia lo faccio da sola... anzi, lasciamelo fare. Devo far vedere quanto valgo a quelli che mi prendevano in giro dandomi dell'orsa. ...Scherzo, eh.

jp: これだけの大仕事、国が報酬とか出してくれてもいいと思うんだけどなぁ。まぁいいや、勝手にやったことだし。
jp_grezzo: "これだけの大仕事、国が報酬とか出してくれてもいいと思うんだけどなぁ。まぁいいや、勝手にやったことだし。"
en: After this achievement, they must just give us some big rewards. Well, I would've done it anyways.
en_grezzo: "After this achievement, they must just give us some big rewards. Well, I would've done it anyways."
it: Per un lavorone così lo Stato un compenso lo darebbe. Vabbè, l'abbiamo fatto di testa nostra.

jp: あんまり知られてないけど、実はここって観光名所みたいな扱いで、実際に城として使われてはいないんだよね。それを知って驚く観光客がとても多いんだけど、あれはなんなの？メイルーンの人間は氷の建物やカマクラで生活しているとでも思っているの？
jp_grezzo: "あんまり知られてないけど、実はここって観光名所みたいな扱いで、実際に城として使われてはいないんだよね。それを知って驚く観光客がとても多いんだけど、あれはなんなの？メイルーンの人間は氷の建物やカマクラで生活しているとでも思っているの？"
en: You might not be aware, but this place is more of a tourist area than an actual castle. Still, most tourists are surprised when they hear that. Isn't that funny? What, do people really think people in Mayroon live in snow huts and buildings made of ice?
en_grezzo: "You might not be aware, but this place is more of a tourist area than an actual castle. Still, most tourists are surprised when they hear that. Isn't that funny? What, do people really think people in Mayroon live in snow huts and buildings made of ice?"
it: Non lo sa quasi nessuno, ma questo posto è un'attrazione turistica: come castello non lo usa più nessuno. Tanti turisti restano di sasso a sentirlo... ma che gli prende? Credono che a Mayroon si viva in case di ghiaccio e capanne di neve?

jp: まぁ…私もメイルーンから出てみるまで、各国に勝手なイメージを抱いていたから偉そうなことは言えないんだけど。
jp_grezzo: "まぁ…私もメイルーンから出てみるまで、各国に勝手なイメージを抱いていたから偉そうなことは言えないんだけど。"
en: Well... I really shouldn't say something like that. I had warped views about other countries until I left Mayroon too.
en_grezzo: "Well... I really shouldn't say something like that. I had warped views about other countries until I left Mayroon too."
it: Be'... nemmeno io posso fare la maestra: finché non sono uscita da Mayroon, degli altri paesi mi ero fatta idee tutte mie.

jp: やれやれ、吹雪の中をものすごい速さで駆け回るから振り落とされるかと思ったよ。…なんかガタガタ震えてるけど大丈夫かい？
jp_grezzo: "やれやれ、吹雪の中をものすごい速さで駆け回るから振り落とされるかと思ったよ。…なんかガタガタ震えてるけど大丈夫かい？"
en: Whew. I thought we were going to get thrown off traveling at that speed in a snow storm... You okay? You're trembling.
en_grezzo: "Whew. I thought we were going to get thrown off traveling at that speed in a snow storm... You okay? You're trembling."
it: Uff, correvano a una velocità tale in mezzo alla bufera che credevo di volare giù. ...Senti, stai tremando come una foglia: tutto bene?

jp: それはともかく、ここがメイルーンの氷の城さ。前回で、街々は解放してきたんだけど城は守りが固くて突破できなかったんだ。今回狙うのは最奥に陣取ってる悪魔の首。あいつさえ仕留めれば、残りの雑魚は私一人でも片づけられる。
jp_grezzo: "それはともかく、ここがメイルーンの氷の城さ。前回で、街々は解放してきたんだけど城は守りが固くて突破できなかったんだ。今回狙うのは最奥に陣取ってる悪魔の首。あいつさえ仕留めれば、残りの雑魚は私一人でも片づけられる。"
en: Anyways, this is the Ice Castle of Mayroon. I managed to make it through the town last time, but the castle's defenses were too strong. We need to take care of the demon that's in the castle. If we can take him down, I can handle the rest of the small-fry alone.
en_grezzo: "Anyways, this is the Ice Castle of Mayroon. I managed to make it through the town last time, but the castle's defenses were too strong. We need to take care of the demon that's in the castle. If we can take him down, I can handle the rest of the small-fry alone."
it: Comunque: questa è la Rocca Ghiacciata di Mayroon. La volta scorsa i paesi li avevo liberati, ma il castello era difeso troppo bene. Stavolta puntiamo al capo dei demoni, acquartierato in fondo. Fatto fuori lui, i pesci piccoli me li tolgo di mezzo da sola.

jp: …それにしても酷い有様だ、前来た時よりもボロボロになってるよ。床にも屋根にも大穴が開いている、奥まで辿り着けるか…？
jp_grezzo: "…それにしても酷い有様だ、前来た時よりもボロボロになってるよ。床にも屋根にも大穴が開いている、奥まで辿り着けるか…？"
en: ...Still, this place is in even worse condition than when I was here last time. Will we even be able to make it inside with how much damage has been done...?
en_grezzo: "...Still, this place is in even worse condition than when I was here last time. Will we even be able to make it inside with how much damage has been done...?"
it: ...Però che disastro: è ridotta peggio di quando ci sono venuta l'ultima volta. Buchi enormi nel pavimento e nel tetto... ci arriveremo, in fondo?

jp: あれ？君どこかで会ったっけ？まぁいいや。君、強そうだね。ちょっと一緒に来てほしいんだ。
jp_grezzo: "あれ？君どこかで会ったっけ？まぁいいや。君、強そうだね。ちょっと一緒に来てほしいんだ。"
en: Huh? Have I met you before? Well, whatever. You look strong to me. I want you to join me.
en_grezzo: "Huh? Have I met you before? Well, whatever. You look strong to me. I want you to join me."
it: Eh? Ma noi ci conosciamo? Vabbè. Tu hai l'aria di essere forte: vorrei che venissi con me.

jp: 化け物を倒そうと慌てて故郷に戻ったんだけど、予想以上に敵が多くてあと一歩のところで撤退せざるをえなくてさ。ホント参っちゃうよ、わざわざ徒歩で雪原と氷河渡ったのに。
jp_grezzo: "化け物を倒そうと慌てて故郷に戻ったんだけど、予想以上に敵が多くてあと一歩のところで撤退せざるをえなくてさ。ホント参っちゃうよ、わざわざ徒歩で雪原と氷河渡ったのに。"
en: I returned to my hometown to defeat the monsters that attacked, but there were more enemies than I had anticipated. I had no choice but to withdraw. Walking across snow fields and glaciers is really annoying, you know.
en_grezzo: "I returned to my hometown to defeat the monsters that attacked, but there were more enemies than I had anticipated. I had no choice but to withdraw. Walking across snow fields and glaciers is really annoying, you know."
it: Sono tornata di corsa al mio paese per abbattere il mostro, ma i nemici erano molti più del previsto e a un passo dalla fine ho dovuto ritirarmi. Che rabbia, davvero: e pensare che i campi di neve e il ghiacciaio me li ero fatti a piedi.

jp: 大丈夫、大丈夫。誰が用意したのか知らないけどさっき犬ぞりが置いてあるの見つけたから、それを使わせてもらおう。歩いていく必要はないよ。めちゃくちゃでかい犬だからクレバスにも落ちないんじゃないかな。
jp_grezzo: "大丈夫、大丈夫。誰が用意したのか知らないけどさっき犬ぞりが置いてあるの見つけたから、それを使わせてもらおう。歩いていく必要はないよ。めちゃくちゃでかい犬だからクレバスにも落ちないんじゃないかな。"
en: Don't worry though, it'll be fine. I don't know who prepared it, but I found a dogsled a little while ago. Let's use that. No need to walk! And since the dogs looked like they've been trained, we shouldn't have to worry about falling into a crevasse either.
en_grezzo: "Don't worry though, it'll be fine. I don't know who prepared it, but I found a dogsled a little while ago. Let's use that. No need to walk! And since the dogs looked like they've been trained, we shouldn't have to worry about falling into a crevasse either."
it: Ma no, niente paura. Non so chi ce l'abbia messa, ma poco fa ho trovato una slitta trainata dai cani: usiamo quella. Non c'è bisogno di andarci a piedi. Sono cani enormi, in un crepaccio non ci cascano di sicuro.

jp: いつまでも準備に時間かけてるわけにはいかない。さぁ、出発しようか。
jp_grezzo: "いつまでも準備に時間かけてるわけにはいかない。さぁ、出発しようか。"
en: We can't stay and prepare forever. Ready to go?
en_grezzo: "We can't stay and prepare forever. Ready to go?"
it: Non possiamo prepararci all'infinito. Su, partiamo?

jp: なにボサっとしてるのさ。ほら、行くよ。
jp_grezzo: "なにボサっとしてるのさ。ほら、行くよ。"
en: What are you mumbling about? Come on, let's go.
en_grezzo: "What are you mumbling about? Come on, let's go."
it: Che fai lì a bocca aperta? Su, si va.

jp: ちょっと！私の話を聞いてくれよ！
jp_grezzo: "ちょっと！私の話を聞いてくれよ！"
en: Hey! Come on, listen to me!
en_grezzo: "Hey! Come on, listen to me!"
it: Ehi! Ascoltami quando ti parlo!

jp: うわっ！？
jp_grezzo: "うわっ！？"
en: Uwaah?!
en_grezzo: "Uwaah?!"
it: Uaah?!

jp: 大丈夫
jp_grezzo: "大丈夫"
en: I'm fine.
en_grezzo: "I'm fine."
it: Sto bene

jp: 骨が折れた
jp_grezzo: "骨が折れた"
en: It's broken.
en_grezzo: "It's broken."
it: Mi si è rotto un osso

jp: あなたが銀熊か
jp_grezzo: "あなたが銀熊か"
en: Are you the Silver Bear?
en_grezzo: "Are you the Silver Bear?"
it: Sei tu l'orsa d'argento?

jp: わ、悪いね。怪我はないかい？
jp_grezzo: "わ、悪いね。怪我はないかい？"
en: S-Sorry about that. You're not hurt, are you?
en_grezzo: "S-Sorry about that. You're not hurt, are you?"
it: S-scusa. Tutto a posto? Niente di rotto?

jp: そんなことより大変なんだよ！下の階で変な三人組を見かけてさ。不審に思って物陰から様子を窺っていたんだ。すると三人組の一人が突然…何て言ったらいいのかな、空間を捻じ曲げて別の空間と繋いだというか…とにかく見間違えるはずがない、繋げた先、あれは確かに私の故郷の風景だった。
jp_grezzo: "そんなことより大変なんだよ！下の階で変な三人組を見かけてさ。不審に思って物陰から様子を窺っていたんだ。すると三人組の一人が突然…何て言ったらいいのかな、空間を捻じ曲げて別の空間と繋いだというか…とにかく見間違えるはずがない、繋げた先、あれは確かに私の故郷の風景だった。"
en: Ah, but more importantly! I saw some weird trio on the lower level. They looked suspicious, so I spied on them from the shadows.. Then one of them suddenly... I'm not sure how to say it, but it's like they distorted space to connect it to another place... Well anyways it was something like that I'm sure of it. Anyways, what I'm definitely sure of is that the space they connected to was my hometown.
en_grezzo: "Ah, but more importantly! I saw some weird trio on the lower level. They looked suspicious, so I spied on them from the shadows.. Then one of them suddenly... I'm not sure how to say it, but it's like they distorted space to connect it to another place... Well anyways it was something like that I'm sure of it. Anyways, what I'm definitely sure of is that the space they connected to was my hometown."
it: Ma lascia stare quello: c'è un guaio grosso! Al piano di sotto ho visto tre tizi strani. Mi sono insospettita e li ho spiati da dietro un riparo. E a un certo punto uno dei tre... come dire, ha storto lo spazio e l'ha attaccato a un altro spazio... Comunque sia, io non posso essermi sbagliata: là dall'altra parte c'era il paesaggio del mio paese, di sicuro.

jp: 恐ろしいこととは？
jp_grezzo: "恐ろしいこととは？"
en: Can you be more specific?
en_grezzo: "Can you be more specific?"
it: Che cose terribili?

jp: どうでもいい
jp_grezzo: "どうでもいい"
en: It doesn't matter.
en_grezzo: "It doesn't matter."
it: Non m'importa

jp: それは知っている
jp_grezzo: "それは知っている"
en: I already know.
en_grezzo: "I already know."
it: Questo lo so già

jp: そしてあいつらは巨大な化け物を私の故郷に送り込むと、恐ろしいことを話しながら下へと降りて行ったんだ…。
jp_grezzo: "そしてあいつらは巨大な化け物を私の故郷に送り込むと、恐ろしいことを話しながら下へと降りて行ったんだ…。"
en: They sent an enormous monster through the distortion into my hometown, and then started talking about other terrible things as they headed further down...
en_grezzo: "They sent an enormous monster through the distortion into my hometown, and then started talking about other terrible things as they headed further down..."
it: E quelli, dopo aver spedito un mostro enorme nel mio paese, sono scesi giù parlando di cose terribili...

jp: あなたを探していた
jp_grezzo: "あなたを探していた"
en: I was looking for you.
en_grezzo: "I was looking for you."
it: Ti stavo cercando

jp: 話を聞いてほしい
jp_grezzo: "話を聞いてほしい"
en: Listen to me.
en_grezzo: "Listen to me."
it: Ascoltami

jp: メルガストのことを教える
jp_grezzo: "メルガストのことを教える"
en: Let me tell you about the Melugast.
en_grezzo: "Let me tell you about the Melugast."
it: Ti parlo del Melugast

jp: じゃあ私は故郷が心配だからもう行くよ。なんとしてでも地上に降りてやるつもりさ！
jp_grezzo: "じゃあ私は故郷が心配だからもう行くよ。なんとしてでも地上に降りてやるつもりさ！"
en: I'm worried about my home, so I'm going to head back. I'm going to find some way back to the surface, no matter what it takes!
en_grezzo: "I'm worried about my home, so I'm going to head back. I'm going to find some way back to the surface, no matter what it takes!"
it: Be', io sono in pensiero per il mio paese, quindi vado. In superficie ci torno a ogni costo!

jp: あなたの話を聞かず、冒険者は階段を駆けあがっていった…。
jp_grezzo: "あなたの話を聞かず、冒険者は階段を駆けあがっていった…。"
en: The adventurer ran up the stairs without listening to anything you had to say...
en_grezzo: "The adventurer ran up the stairs without listening to anything you had to say..."
it: Senza starti ad ascoltare, l'avventuriera è corsa su per le scale...
